description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window_gmt.description: Signals are only generated inside this window. Outside it, the routine exits silently.

macro_kill_switches.description: Any condition set true fires a kill-switch — no signals are issued that day.

confluence.description: min_categories_for_buy: raise to 5 for higher conviction-only days. max_signals_per_run: never exceed 3 concurrent signals.

risk.description: stop = entry - (stop_atr_multiplier × ATR14). target = entry + (target_atr_multiplier × ATR14). R:R must be >= min_rr.

earnings.description: Tickers within blackout_trading_days_before of earnings (or blackout_trading_days_after since last earnings) are excluded. First eligible day after blackout requires post_earnings_confluence_boost extra confirms.

vix_regime.description: VIX <15 = complacency (tighter stops). 15-20 = normal. 20-25 = caution (only HIGH confidence 5-6/6). 25-30 = tighten further + size note. >30 = kill-switch fires.

volume.description: Volume as % of 20-day average. Below weak_threshold = auto non-confirm. Breakout candles need breakout_min_pct.
